scoring_architecture.design: tests/test.sh derives no reward of its own: it locates a root-owned interpreter and execs the root-owned trusted parent tests/supervise_multimodal_merge.py. The parent holds the case list and the expectations, creates the reward file exclusively with a leading 0 (root:root, mode 0600, inside a root:root 0700 directory), and runs candidate code only in unprivileged setpriv --reuid=1000 --regid=1000 --no-new-privs observation subprocesses. A case counts as passed only when its subprocess exits 0 and prints exactly one observation line carrying that case's unguessable nonce.
scoring_architecture.review_item: P0 - reward was previously keyed off the exit status of a process that imports candidate-modifiable vllm.
properties_verified: premature termination with status 0 (os._exit and SystemExit) yields reward 0
completion evidence cannot be forged by candidate code (per-case nonce, single accepted line)
the reward file cannot be written, unlinked, rmtree'd or symlinked by candidate code
killing the trusted parent leaves the initial 0 in place

cardinality_behaviour_on_cuda.review_item: P1 - the oracle relied on the indexed assignment raising, but a broadcastable 1 -> N mismatch succeeds silently.
cardinality_behaviour_on_cuda.method: Each shape measured in its own process, because a non-broadcastable mismatch against a CUDA mask raises a device-side assert that poisons the CUDA context. Measured on the declared CUDA scenario; no CPU-only probe substitutes for a CUDA result.
cardinality_behaviour_on_cuda.oracle_fix: The oracle now validates cardinality before the indexed assignment on the CPU-mask path, where counting the mask does not synchronize the accelerator's stream. Verifier regressions cardinality_cpu_1_to_3 and cardinality_cpu_1_to_9 cover the broadcastable shapes.
cardinality_behaviour_on_cuda.fairness_decision: No cardinality case is graded on the same-device (CUDA mask) path. The unmodified base and the declared alternative both accept a same-device 5 -> 3 mismatch, so requiring a clean error there would grade one particular design rather than the declared contract.

oracle_patch_self_evidence.method: The task image ships runtime dependencies only (no pytest), so both upstream test bodies were driven directly with an explicit vllm.__file__.startswith('/workspace/repo/') binding assertion on a real CUDA device.

resource_threshold_calibration.review_item: Justify the mask-transfer constraint and peak_ratio < 4 against an observable resource goal, validated by repeated measurement.
resource_threshold_calibration.metric: peak temporary CUDA allocation during the merge divided by the size of the target inputs_embeds tensor
resource_threshold_calibration.jitter: none; every repeat produced an identical value
resource_threshold_calibration.rationale: Two independently written passing designs both measure 1.003 / 0.500, while every design that keeps materialising the full request-length mask on the device measures 5.509 / 2.588. The gate at 4.0 separates 'temporaries proportional to the placeholders' from 'temporaries proportional to the whole request' with a wide margin on both sides, without prescribing an exact curve. The peak ratios did not regress after the P1 oracle fix.
